profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Itron, Inc.
profile.summary:
Gerson Garcia has more than 30 years of experience in IT industry, infrastructure tools and monitoring applications. He has worked in all steps in a standard development model, Analysis, design, coding, testing, implementing and supporting, small, medium and large environments.
He is an expert in the area of system and tool integration and developing and implementing plug-ins to manage large-scale monitoring environments.  Gerson demonstrates technical expertise and innovative solutions for scripting re-useable and expandable performance and capacity measurements.  He effectively utilizes technical and team skills to work in global and virtual teams as well as demonstrates the ability to work as an individual performer under minimal direction.
He has large experience in training as instructor at a Community College.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Monitoring and automations for Smart Grid applications and appliances
Nagios, Splunk, Monolith, Ansible and Docker.

positions.title: Operations Engineer Sr
positions.description:
Monitoring and automations for Smart Grid applications and appliances
Nagios, Splunk, Monolith

positions.title: Master IT Specialist
positions.description:
Migrate Tivoli monitoring support for large account from USA to Brazil
• Assessed and understand customer environment.
• Deployed support migration plan.
• Built training requirements (Knowledge Transfer).
• Provided Tivoli training for L1/L2 support.

Develop automation scripts
• Developed perl script to automate basic day at day support tasks
• Created elegant script to provide Menu like application for more advanced support tasks.
• Created web sites to provide report for ITM6 Agent health and secure checking.

Migrate legacy monitoring solution to state of art IBM product
• Install ITM6 HTEMS, TEPS and RTEMS for management systems.
• Planed and executed ITM6 Agent installation on more than 3000 customer servers
• Implemented non existent monitoring tools such IBM ITCAM for Transactions, MQ Agents, 
Database and MS Applications Monitoring.
• Migrate TEC to Netcool Omnibus.

Acquired IBM products Certifications
• IBM Service Management Network and Service Assurance V3 Certified
• IBM Tivoli Monitoring V6.2.2 Implementation Certified
• IBM Tivoli Netcool/OMNIbus V7.3 Implementation Certified
• IBM Tivoli Network Manager IP Edition V3.9 Deployment Certified
• IBM Service Management Network and Service Assurance V3 Certified
• IBM IT Specialist Expertise Level Certified
• OpenGroup Master IT Specialist Certified

positions.title: Information Specialist Senior
positions.description:
Provide production experience to development engineering 
• Review client requirements
• Design and assemble integration packages
• Represent engineering team for new product integrations
• Develop and deliver training to engineering team on new products
Develop and implement application performance measurements
• Developed solution to measure application performance
• Solution leverageable and deployed to other tools in organization
Developed product integration solutions
• Designed, tested, documented and implemented integration point into Virtual Control Center from HPOV, HPOM, CA-Unicenter and IBM Tivoli
Engineering integration project for EDS to HP tools
• Key engineer for planning, documenting and testing EDS/HP tool integration points.

positions.title: Continuing Education Instructor
positions.description:
Recruited to analyze, plan, build and teach IT classes for Continuing Education
• Proposed and developed Virtualization course using VMWare
• Proposed, developed and instruct Unix System Administration I and II courses
• Proposed, developed and instruct Linux Administration I and II courses
• Instruct Introduction and Advanced PHP & MySQL course

positions.title: Infrastructure Specialist
positions.description:
Deploy and support Virtual Control Center (VCC) application
• Solaris infrastructure hosting EDS customized IBM Netcool, BMC Remedy and Oracle
• Integrated CA-Unicenter, BMC Patrol and IBM Tivoli SNMP traps to VCC
• Developed and deployed automated device configuration solution into BMC Remedy
• Created HTML CGI scripts to retrieve log data from VCC components
• Developed and delivered training to end users
• Developed and delivered training to peer support teams
• Developed and deployed scripts to measure VCC application and infrastructure health. Solution used to populate business analysis dashboard and leveraged to other applications in the organization
Upgrade legacy event automation environment
• Installed IBM Tivoli and decommissioned BMC Patrol 
• Developed script to migrate devices monitored by BMC Patrol into IBM Tivoli
• Developed and implemented auto-discovery solution for objects managed by IBM Tivoli
• Migrated device monitoring from HPOV to CA-Unicenter and decommissioned HPOV

positions.title: Multiplatform Analyst
positions.description:
Relocated to California from Brazil for International assignment focused on migrating to standard, cost effective tools and processes
• Implement and support HPOV
• Develop documentation for standard monitoring processes and actions for Operations
• Develop communication and process sharing between teams in US and Brazil
• Develop solution enabling Operations to switch between HPOV and BMC Patrol consoles
• Supported implementation of ISO9000 and certification process
• Migrated monitoring from HPOV to CA-Unicenter

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
• Upgrade 10 Novel 3.1 server to 4.11 with no user impact
• Integrate Novel 4.11 with database applications
• Developed and implemented Common Desktop Environment for EDS Brazil following standards documented by US engineering

positions.title: Systems Analyst Senior
positions.description:
Support legacy IT system (text editor, print system, mini computer with slave terminals) and subsequent migration to Unix and Novel
Developed and implemented multiple programs enabling work efficiencies and cost savings
• Developed a program to automatically read a flat file with adds and format with the space designated by the page designer using the publishing tool
• Developed a program to retrieve economic indexes and formatted it based on the design of the page available.
• Developed a “plug-in” to allow modem transmit of text from remote locations to the newspaper press-room widely used in games, special occasions and concerts such Rolling Stones and U2 and US Soccer World Cup in 1994.

honors.title: OpenGroup Master IT Specialist Certified
honors.description: The Open Group Certified IT Specialist (Open CITS) certification program is an independent global certification program for qualifying the skills, knowledge and experience of IT specialists. Accepted and applicable worldwide, Open CITS boasts over 2,500 certified professionals from a wide range of organizations in more than 50 countries worldwide.

honors.title: IBM Service Management Network and Service Assurance Certificate
honors.description: An IBM Certified Advanced Deployment Professional - IBM Service Management Network and Service Assurance V3 is an individual who has demonstrated a higher level of implementation knowledge and skill both in breadth and in depth in the IBM Tivoli Network and Service Assurance solutions area.
